calc-1.name: VAT Calculator
calc-1.intro: Convert between tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive amounts and compute the VAT payable from the applicable rate.

calc-2.name: Corporate Income Tax Prepayment Calculator
calc-2.intro: Estimate the quarterly corporate income tax prepayment from taxable profit and the applicable tax rate.

analysis-cost-5.name: Cost Accounting and Analysis Method
analysis-cost-5.intro: Classify and analyze product costs, separate fixed from variable cost thresholds and produce descriptive cost statistics.

report-2.name: Bookkeeping and Financial Statement Preparation
report-2.intro: Support voucher, ledger and financial statement preparation with account balance summaries and trial balance checks.

split-bill.name: Split Bill Calculator
split-bill.intro: Split a total bill, including tip, evenly between any number of people and show each person's share.

roe-calc.name: Return on Equity (ROE) Calculator
roe-calc.intro: Compute return on equity from net income and average shareholders' equity to gauge the return on invested capital.

roa-calc.name: Return on Assets (ROA) Calculator
roa-calc.intro: Compute return on assets from net income and average total assets to measure the profit generated per unit of assets.

roe-dupont.name: DuPont ROE Analysis Calculator
roe-dupont.intro: Decompose ROE into net profit margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier to identify the drivers of shareholder return.

assessor-risk-11.name: Financial Risk Assessment and Early-Warning Model
assessor-risk-11.intro: Build a corporate financial risk model from debt, cash flow and profitability inputs and output a risk grade with early-warning signals.

interest-coverage.name: Interest Coverage Ratio Calculator
interest-coverage.intro: Compute the interest coverage ratio as EBIT divided by interest expense to measure the margin of safety for creditors.

ebitda.name: EBITDA Calculator
ebitda.intro: Compute EBITDA by adding depreciation and amortization back to EBIT to assess operating cash generation.

ebit.name: EBIT Calculator
ebit.intro: Compute earnings before interest and taxes from revenue, operating cost and operating expenses.

days-payable-outstanding.name: Days Payable Outstanding Calculator
days-payable-outstanding.intro: Compute DPO from accounts payable and annual cost of goods sold to understand and plan the payment cycle.

days-sales-outstanding.name: Days Sales Outstanding Calculator
days-sales-outstanding.intro: Compute DSO from accounts receivable and annual revenue to evaluate collection efficiency and cash tie-up.

cash-conversion-cycle.name: Cash Conversion Cycle Calculator
cash-conversion-cycle.intro: Compute the cash conversion cycle as DSO + DIO minus DPO from receivable, inventory and payable days.

debt-service-coverage.name: Debt Service Coverage Ratio Calculator
debt-service-coverage.intro: Compute DSCR from operating cash flow and annual debt service to assess loan repayment capacity.

free-cash-flow.name: Free Cash Flow Calculator
free-cash-flow.intro: Compute free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditure for valuation and dividend capacity analysis.

contribution-margin.name: Contribution Margin Calculator
contribution-margin.intro: Compute the unit contribution margin and contribution margin ratio from unit price and unit variable cost for cost-volume-profit analysis.

operating-cash-flow.name: Operating Cash Flow Calculator
operating-cash-flow.intro: Compute operating cash flow from net income, depreciation and amortization and changes in working capital.

break-even-units.name: Break-Even Point Calculator
break-even-units.intro: Compute the break-even sales volume from fixed cost, unit price and unit variable cost using fixed cost / (price - variable cost).

debt-to-asset.name: Debt-to-Asset Ratio Calculator
debt-to-asset.intro: Compute the debt-to-asset ratio from total liabilities and total assets to gauge leverage and long-term solvency.

analysis-46.name: Financial Analysis, Decision and Forecasting Model
analysis-46.intro: Model financial analysis, decision-making and forecasting: enter historical financial data to obtain trend readouts and scenario estimates.

net-profit-margin.name: Net Profit Margin Calculator
net-profit-margin.intro: Compute the net profit margin from net income and revenue to assess final profitability and earnings quality.

quick-ratio.name: Quick Ratio Calculator
quick-ratio.intro: Compute the quick ratio from current assets, inventory and current liabilities to assess short-term solvency excluding inventory.

depreciation-declining.name: Double Declining Balance Depreciation Calculator
depreciation-declining.intro: Compute accelerated depreciation with the double declining balance method from cost, salvage value and useful life.

current-ratio.name: Current Ratio Calculator
current-ratio.intro: Compute the current ratio from current assets and current liabilities to assess short-term solvency.

inventory-days.name: Inventory Days (DIO) Calculator
inventory-days.intro: Compute days inventory outstanding from inventory balance and annual cost of goods sold to optimize stock management.

working-capital.name: Working Capital Calculator
working-capital.intro: Compute net working capital from current assets and current liabilities for cash flow planning and liquidity management.

asset-turnover.name: Asset Turnover Ratio Calculator
asset-turnover.intro: Compute total asset turnover from revenue and average total assets to gauge how efficiently assets generate sales.

amortization-intangible.name: Intangible Asset Straight-Line Amortization Calculator
amortization-intangible.intro: Compute annual amortization of an intangible asset from cost, residual value and useful life using the straight-line method.

inventory-turnover.name: Inventory Turnover Calculator
inventory-turnover.intro: Compute inventory turnover and turnover days from cost of goods sold and average inventory balance.

depreciation-straight.name: Straight-Line Depreciation Calculator
depreciation-straight.intro: Compute annual depreciation and the depreciation rate with the straight-line method from cost, salvage value and useful life.

gross-margin.name: Gross Margin Calculator
gross-margin.intro: Compute the gross margin from revenue and cost of goods sold to support pricing strategy and profit structure analysis.

gross-profit.name: Gross Profit Calculator
gross-profit.intro: Compute gross profit and gross margin from revenue and cost of goods sold.

depreciation-syd.name: Sum-of-Years-Digits Depreciation Calculator
depreciation-syd.intro: Compute accelerated depreciation with the sum-of-years-digits method using year = (n - k + 1) / SYD x (cost - salvage).
